gates.citation: Ordinary least squares. Reference impls: base R stats::lm / summary.lm and scipy.stats.linregress. Data: vertical-GRF push-off peak (PhysioMoCap::grfLandmarks) regressed on age in GaitRec healthy controls (Horsak et al. 2020).

reference.citation: Ordinary least squares. Reference impls: base R stats::lm / summary.lm and scipy.stats.linregress. Data: vertical-GRF push-off peak (PhysioMoCap::grfLandmarks) regressed on age in GaitRec healthy controls (Horsak et al. 2020).
reference.description: re-fits the OLS regression of the vertical-GRF push-off peak on age with base R lm and scipy.stats.linregress and confirms linearRegression reproduces the slope, R-squared and slope p-value bit-for-bit; also reports the per-decade slope, the negative-slope direction and the sample size
